deadline.value: The deadline is January 5, 2027 for fall 2027 admission; earlier applications are encouraged.
deadline.quote: January 5 is the deadline, but submission of application materials earlier is strongly encouraged.

fee_waiver.value: The department waives the application fee only for domestic applicants who apply before December 1.
fee_waiver.quote: At the moment, only Domestic applicants who submit their application prior to December 1st are eligible for application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are optional.
gre_general.quote: GRE and Subject GRE scores are optional.

gre_subject.quote: GRE and Subject GRE scores are optional.

supervisor.value: No faculty sponsor is needed; first-year students rotate through three labs before choosing one.
supervisor.quote: No, all first year students will do 3 rotations in different labs during their first semester.

funding.value: All graduate students in good standing receive full tuition remission and a competitive stipend.
funding.quote: All our graduate students in good standing receive full tuition remission and a competitive stipend.

entry_route.value: Students are recruited directly into the PhD, with no master's first.
entry_route.quote: all students are recruited directly into our Ph.D. program

notes: The FAQ says the Graduate School's minimum TOEFL is 80, but the Graduate School page says 4.5; the university value is kept. The FAQ says most successful applicants score above 90, which is an expectation rather than a rule. Stipend is listed as $33,000 on the FAQ.
